title: Sir Lucan D'Lere
summary: Prepare for a second form when the living Lucan falls.
overview: Defeating Sir Lucan triggers a second NPC at his exact death position. Keep the group ready for another enemy instead of dispersing after the first kill.

phases.label: Second form
phases.description: The death script spawns NPC template 9147 at the death location.
